surface_value: If you have the factor V Leiden mutation, you are at greater risk of developing blood clots. This abnormal clotting most commonly occurs in either the deep veins of the legs (deep vein thrombosis), or in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). Not everyone who has factor V Leiden experiences abnormal clotting, but there is a higher risk for those that do.
